question: According to the 2024-25 Indian Union Budget, the Government has allocated increased funding towards schemes like 'Sambal' from ₹462 crore in the previous fiscal year to _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹629 crore**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **2024-25 Indian Union Budget increased funding for schemes like Samba**l. 
 
• The **Government has allocated increased funding towards schemes like 'Sambal' from ₹462 crore in the previous fiscal year to ₹629 crore**
 
• ​The** budget allocated ₹11,11,111 crore for infrastructure, which is 3.4% of GDP**. 
 
• The** budget also allocated ₹1.5 lakh crore to states as long-term interest-free loans. **
 
• The budget also** allocated funds for flood management, landslides, and related projects in Assam, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, and Sikki**m. 
 
• The budget allocated funds for PM Vishwakarma, PM SVANidhi, National Livelihood Missions, and Stand-Up India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Department of Economic Affairs** under the Ministry of Finance has been entrusted with the responsibility of preparation and presentation of the Union Budget to Parliament.
 
• It formulates and monitors the country's economic policies and programs having a bearing on domestic and international aspects of economic management.
 
 
• **Headquarters - **New Delhi
 
• **Ministry - **Ministry of Finance
 
• **Finance Minister - **Smt. Nirmala Sitharaman (As of July 2022)
 
 
 
• The Union Budget is also referred to as the **Annual Financial Statement** in **Article 112** of the Constitution of India.
 
• It is the annual budget of the Republic of India.
